newsitem.title: CHINA: Guangdong ITIC in US$50 million term loan.
newsitem.headline: Guangdong ITIC in US$50 million term loan.

text.p: Guangdong International Trust & Investment Corp has launched a US$50 million term loan facility, coordinating arranger Societe Generale Asia said on Friday.
The one-year loan pays a margin of 25 basis points over the London Interbank Offered Rate.
Fees are 35 basis points for arrangers committing US$7 million and 30 basis points for lead managers committing US$5 million.
Proceeds of the facility will be used for general working capital.
